sections.title: WHY DO WOMEN LOSE HAIR?
bullets: Genetics (female androgenic alopecia)
Hormonal imbalance – pregnancy, menopause, PCOS
Stress, iron deficiency, poor nutrition
Infections and post-viral conditions, including hair loss after COVID-19
Part line (middle of the scalp)
Crown (visible scalp through hair)
Frontal area (receding hairline at the forehead)
text: Hair loss in women is increasingly common – and no longer taboo.

sections.title: WHAT DOES THE TREATMENT LOOK LIKE?
bullets: The treatment is done in 2–3 sessions, 7–14 days apart
Performed carefully between existing hairs
Pigment tones are blended with your natural hair color
No shaving, no scars, no downtime
text: After the treatment, you can wash your hair and continue with daily activities.

list.q: Does SMP treatment reduce hair growth?
list.a: No. Pigment is applied superficially, without affecting hair follicles.
No – if done properly, only you know it’s there. The result is natural and subtle.

list.q: How long does the SMP effect last for women?
list.a: 2 to 4 years, after which a single touch-up session can be done.

list.q: What if the hair thins more later?
list.a: SMP can be adjusted and enhanced – the effect is adapted to the new condition.
